AND spec review iteration-5 findings FIND-401..405 resolved)' -- one full iteration AHEAD of what lending cites. Given lending's own Dependencies section explicitly commits to treating this exact dependency-drift as a live, must-re-verify-each-revision risk, and that re-verification (performed this session) shows the citation is stale by a full iteration with materially relevant new findings, this is a genuine, not merely theoretical, spec_fidelity failure.
